title: RIP BioWare: EA shuts down storied RPG studio after over three decades
gist: EA is closing BioWare, the studio behind Mass Effect and Dragon Age, and ending early development of the next Mass Effect, as part of about 400 job cuts across EA (50 at BioWare), following the company's $55 billion take-private.

insights.claim: BioWare announced it is closing and ending early development of the next Mass Effect project, minutes after Bloomberg reported 400 job cuts across EA including 50 at BioWare.
insights.speaker: Kyle Orland
insights.so_what: Studio closure and IP development halt signal EA cutting lower-return franchises.

insights.claim: EA executives told staff they are aligning talent and investments with the greatest opportunities for players and long-term growth.
insights.speaker: Kyle Orland
insights.so_what: Capital is being concentrated in priority franchises.
insights.quote: Across our portfolio, we’re making deliberate choices to align talent and investments

insights.claim: EA went private last year in a $55 billion deal led by Silver Lake, Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund and Jared Kushner's Affinity Partners, and analysts predicted layoffs, studio closures and IP sales.
insights.speaker: Kyle Orland
insights.so_what: Leveraged ownership drives cost cutting and focus on live services, sports and microtransactions.
insights.locator: Of course, EA doesn’t have public stockholders anymore

insights.claim: Analysts expected the newly private, heavily debt-ridden EA to focus more on live services, annual sports franchises and microtransactions to increase profits.
insights.speaker: Kyle Orland
insights.so_what: Expect further portfolio pruning toward recurring-revenue franchises.
insights.locator: Of course, EA doesn’t have public stockholders anymore

insights.claim: BioWare's decline included founder departures in 2012, muted receptions for Mass Effect Andromeda and Dragon Age: The Veilguard, and the failed live-service game Anthem, which was recently shut down for good.
insights.speaker: Kyle Orland
insights.so_what: A track record of mixed releases and a failed live-service attempt preceded the closure.
insights.locator: In more recent years, BioWare has also been beset

insights.claim: EA acquired BioWare in 2007, when then-CEO John Riccitiello called it one of the most respected studios and expected it to drive long-term shareholder value.
insights.speaker: Kyle Orland
insights.so_what: Historical context: the acquisition thesis did not endure.
